description: This file defines the interface for a Text-to-Speech (TTS) component, including configuration, notification callbacks, and control methods for speech synthesis.

classes.name: ITextToSpeech
classes.description: Interface for Text-to-Speech functionalities, including configuration, speech control, and notifications.

classes.name: ITextToSpeech::INotification
classes.description: Callback interface for TTS events such as speech start, pause, complete, and errors.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Register a notification sink for TTS events.

methods.name: RegisterWithCallsign
methods.description: Register a notification sink with a specific callsign.

methods.name: ListVoices
methods.description: List available voices for a given language.

methods.name: Speak
methods.description: Convert text to speech and get a speech ID.

methods.name: GetSpeechState
methods.description: Get current state of a speech by ID.
